shortDescription: Information module for Reserve Ip Subpool

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: groupName
options.description: GroupName query parameter. Name of the group.

options.name: ignoreInheritedGroups
options.description: IgnoreInheritedGroups query parameter. Ignores pools inherited from parent site. Either siteId or ignoreInheritedGroups must be passed. They can also be used together.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. Number of reserve pools to be retrieved. Default is 25 if not specified. Maximum allowed limit is 500.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. Offset/starting row. Indexed from 1.

options.name: poolUsage
options.description: PoolUsage query parameter. Can take values empty, partially-full or empty-partially-full.

options.name: siteId
options.description: SiteId query parameter. Site id of site from which to retrieve associated reserve pools. Either siteId (per site queries) or ignoreInheritedGroups must be used. They can also be used together.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
